caption: The drawing features a red ornate vase with a decorative gold trim, set on a rectangular gray base. The vase holds a bouquet of flowers consisting of one large pink flower with red speckles, a large pale blue flower with blue and pink detailing, several smaller blue flowers, and two round white buds with red tips. There are also multiple green and brown leaves interspersed among the flowers and buds. The background is a solid, muted beige color. The drawing is signed in the bottom right corner with the name "Eugene Croe."
title: Embroidery
